title: teucrium pumilum subsp. lepicephalum
intro: Teucrium pumilum subsp. lepicephalum, commonly known as the dwarf germander, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia, as well as its ability to lower cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Teucrium pumilum subsp. lepicephalum include its sedative and anti-spasmodic effects, which can help reduce muscle tension and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and make it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
